mensajes.limite: Synthetic data for review. This draft is not an issued certificate. It provides no evidence of a signature, seal, verification code, registration or delivery.
mensajes.criterio: Days are copied from the sample, without recalculation or totals. Declared or checked service is not treated as recognised service.
mensajes.servicio: From {{inicio}} to {{fin}}. Category: {{clase}}. Days recorded in the sample: {{dias}}.
mensajes.vacio: No service is recorded in this state.
mensajes.revision: Next step: HR must review the source, decisions, periods, working hours and interruptions before preparing an authorised certificate.
mensajes.sin_servicios: The sample contains no service records. This does not establish that the person has no previous service.
mensajes.cli_uso: Prepare a service record rehearsal draft. Usage: vec-certificados-borrador -ensayo-sintetico -fuente sample.json -salida new-folder [-idioma code]. Run from the repository root. Do not use real data.
mensajes.cli_fuente: Local JSON file with the synthetic sample, in rehearsal format or shaped like the Personnel response.
mensajes.cli_plantilla: File containing the versioned rehearsal template.
mensajes.cli_idioma: Language code from the common index.
mensajes.cli_textos: Message catalogue file for the selected language.
mensajes.cli_salida: New folder for the PDF and JSON; an existing folder is never overwritten.
mensajes.cli_ensayo: Confirm that the input contains only synthetic rehearsal data.
mensajes.cli_ok: Draft prepared in {{salida}}. Review borrador.pdf and borrador.json. No certificate has been issued.
mensajes.error_argumentos: Check the arguments. Specify the sample, a new folder and -ensayo-sintetico. Use -h for help.
mensajes.error_entrada: The draft could not be prepared. Check the sample: it must be synthetic, use valid dates and contain only the permitted fields.
mensajes.error_catalogo: The draft could not be prepared. Check the template, its version and the catalogue for the selected language.
mensajes.error_salida: The draft could not be saved. Choose a new folder and check that you can write to its parent folder.
mensajes.error_no_disponible: The draft could not be prepared. PDF generation is unavailable; try again.
mensajes.cli_indice_idiomas: Common index of available languages and the fallback language.
mensajes.servicio_v1: From {{inicio}} to {{fin}}. Class: {{clase}}, version {{clase_version}}. Act: {{acto}}. Source: {{certeza}}. {{sustenta}}
mensajes.cobertura_completa: Personnel states that the sample contains all of this person's services on this date.
mensajes.cobertura_parcial: Personnel states that the sample is partial: some services may be missing.
mensajes.cobertura_no_acreditada: Personnel does not state whether the sample is complete: no conclusion can be drawn about missing or extra services.
mensajes.servicio_v1_abierto: From {{inicio}}, with no end date (open period). Class: {{clase}}, version {{clase_version}}. Act: {{acto}}. Source: {{certeza}}. {{sustenta}}
mensajes.criterio_v1: Personnel does not provide days and this draft does not calculate them. Only a recognised service with a proven source can support a certificate; a declared or checked service does not become recognised.
mensajes.servicio_v1_al_corte: From {{inicio}}, ongoing at the reference date ({{fin}}); its planned end is later. Class: {{clase}}, version {{clase_version}}. Act: {{acto}}. Source: {{certeza}}. {{sustenta}}
